result.summary: Found several visual/content bugs: invalid delivery price text (€NaN), truncated restaurant names, and a cut-off category chip, plus minor layout polish issues.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows delivery fee as '€NaN delivery', indicating a broken/null price value rendered in the UI.
issues.suggestion: Handle null/undefined delivery fees with a fallback (e.g. 'Free', '—', or hide the fee) and fix the data/formatting so NaN never appears to users.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line names, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with adequate card width so full names remain readable.

issues.description: The category filter chips row is clipped on the right (partial 'Healthy' chip and next chip cut off) with no clear affordance that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll is obvious (fade/peek of next chip, padding) or wrap/resize chips so labels aren’t cut off at the screen edge.

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card (pizza) is partially cut off by the tab bar, making the offer hard to scan without scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding so cards clear the fixed tab bar, or ensure the scroll area accounts for safe-area/tab height.

issues.description: Delivery time badges sit over food images with varying contrast depending on the photo, which can hurt readability.
issues.suggestion: Add a consistent scrim/shadow behind badges or use a solid pill background with stronger contrast.
